title: Prove a sharp torsion bound on precision-agreement density (no κ)
body:
## Summary

```text
Affine rounded-linear reader, precision gap g, finite residue image H
    agreement density <= 1 / |H[2^g]|
    dyadic factors 2^e_i: density <= 2^(-sum_i min(g,e_i))
    coordinate-aligned examples attain the bound for every exponent list
```

Add only `research/dyadic-rounding-agreement-density/`. Claim type: scoped all-dimensional proof with finite corroboration. Three independent order-eight factors and a two-bit gap, for example, have sharp agreement ceiling 1/64. The new step is a finite-subgroup packing argument: each coset of the subgroup killed by 2^g contains at most one safe point.

Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit woklerx #1848 for the affine-lattice universal-cancellation criterion and half-open safe cells, woklerx #1451 for the product-grid boundary, Gareth Davidson's dirty-prefix precision discipline, Chafik Boukhalfa #628 and Ali Romman's retained kernel lineage. Predecessor results are cited premises; no predecessor verifier is imported or replayed. The elementary group ingredients carry no literature-priority claim.

## Evidence

Before: the credited affine-lattice result decides agreement for every input, without a quantitative complete-period frequency bound. After: `PROOF.md` proves the torsion bound, natural-density interpretation and sharp dyadic form for all rational affine readers, offsets and positive precision gaps.

Both warning-strict normal and optimized checks pass locally, each in under one second. They enumerate 93 distinct subgroups, 60,192 offset/gap cases and 599,712 literal point probes. The census has 12,423 tight and 47,769 strict cases. Additional checks cover 16,000 independent Fraction rounding comparisons, 336 sharp coordinate examples with 6,840 scalar probes, 1,168 period/fiber cases, 780 arbitrary-dirty restoration cases and eight semantic controls. Quantified claims rest on the written proof, rather than this finite census.

Generated source-bound receipt comparison passes. Changed numeric and Boolean receipt fields, a changed proof file, full-group overcharging and a wrong sharpness exponent reject. Receipt overwrite is rejected without changing its bytes. Package metadata/pins, committed bytes/source history, official export/integrity and read-only Git-free optimized replay pass at `c8894903e43c144c9f8a19c8c629ad61f2da4e2c`. Registered replay prints `PASS_DYADIC_ROUNDING_AGREEMENT_DENSITY` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/dyadic-rounding-agreement-density
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/dyadic-rounding-agreement-density/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/dyadic-rounding-agreement-density/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/dyadic-rounding-agreement-density --check-source-history
```

CPython 3.12, standard library only. The interpreter path is the local environment; a reviewer can substitute their CPython 3.12 executable. The package has no live external inputs; historical provenance is pinned to canonical main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7. The selected metadata positive control passed. Live PRs, claims, account submissions and merged/main formula/object searches were refreshed before committing. The cached overlap scan covered 395 open PRs and 3,890 Discussion records, but omitted most sparse local notes; separate main-tree README searches were used. This is bounded overlap evidence, not a novelty certificate.

## Limitations

The bound concerns uniform complete parameter periods and natural density in expanding integer boxes. Bounded domains or selected distributions may be entirely safe. It need not be exact for a fixed embedding, and odd-order groups can make it uninformative. Source values must remain unchanged and the separately rounded increments must be added/subtracted exactly. Internally rounded nonlinear leaves, actual reachable-source contracts, physical movement/storage, compiler and supplier admission remain open. No selected-frontier change, new kappa or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No Lean, Docker or full selected cold replay was run.

## Open next questions

- Determine the exact offset maximum for one fixed embedded subgroup, beginning with the cyclic group generated by (1/4,1/2). Simultaneous circular-coordinate constraints remain the obstacle.
- Prove an actual rounded-linear caller's affine-domain closure and complete-period distribution before applying the frequency interpretation. Nonlinear leaf interiors and nonuniform source selection remain separate obligations.

Research stops at this first sharp bound.

## Related open work

The account's open PRs created since the CLAIM were refreshed before completion. Nine other submissions were found; only the following studies the same rounded-linear mixed-precision interface.

- [#4881](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4881) decides universal agreement on bounded affine boxes. This PR bounds agreement density over complete affine-lattice periods. Neither result depends on the other, and no shared numerical quantity is compared.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed on head `c8894903e43c144c9f8a19c8c629ad61f2da4e2c` in [run 39867254426](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39867254426): planning in 2m54s and the registered package replay in 1m11s. Run metadata confirms the exact head, completed status and success. The registered replay executes both warning-strict normal and optimized commands. Every registered check and publication preflight also passed locally; no proof obligation was deferred solely to CI. Hosted execution does not establish independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the universal theorem.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

One isolated proof/replay package. Archival retention does not admit a supplier.

**Blast Radius:** research
